_readme: Replies written for a specific video, shown above the general ones. Key = the video's slug (code word). For every new video add 3-4 replies that fit it, in a light, slightly cynical Israeli tone, and always send people to the link in the bio (links in TikTok comments aren't clickable). Then run: py bot/tiktok/make_replies.py
